_comment: Pinned RTL-flow tool versions, as observed on the dispatch worker. rtl/tests/run.sh and scripts/check-synth-fresh.sh refuse to run if a binary on PATH reports a different version. Nothing here is installed by this repo; a missing or different tool is a worker-spec gap (2AMLogic/2am infra/aws/loom-worker/). The klt pin for synthesis stays in layout/toolchain.json.

cocotb.note: Per-run environment built with uvx (uvx --python <python> --from cocotb==<version>); cocotb 2.0.1 only builds on Python <= 3.13, so the interpreter is pinned. cocotb is not installed on the worker and nothing here installs it host-wide.
